findings.what: Material typography roles retained defaults and the verifier also demanded font assets owned by T1.3.
findings.why_it_matters: Default roles could introduce unapproved type values; font ownership required reconciliation against the build graph.

findings.what: extraSmall and extraLarge retained Material default radii.
findings.why_it_matters: Standard components could render unapproved 4 dp and 28 dp radii.

findings.what: Unassigned Material color roles retained the default palette.
findings.why_it_matters: Standard components could render colors outside the frozen Saaya tokens.

findings.what: The v27 style did not inherit the complete base theme.
findings.why_it_matters: API 27+ could lose the specified dark window and system-bar values.

findings.what: The source pin was not centred inside the adaptive-icon safe zone.
findings.why_it_matters: Aggressive launcher masks could clip it.
It weakened a generated Gradle safety default without authorization.

findings.what: T2.1's diamond merge contract still mandated the obsolete coordinate bounds lat 17.6-17.9 lon 83.1-83.5.
findings.why_it_matters: The graph is the node's resume and execution contract; following the stale instruction would reject the frozen dataset and could regress the corrected parser and test.

findings.what: An already-armed AUTO_ZONE session crashes when its current hour band has no interval-table cell.
findings.why_it_matters: The interval table says n/a cells cannot occur, but an active session can cross into one before OkTapped reschedules or SHADOW recovery runs.

findings.what: SHADOW recovery recomputed the running timer from current Rules instead of preserving its persisted deadline.
findings.why_it_matters: Toggling DEMO before process restart could retroactively shorten the current timer.

findings.what: AUTO_ZONE exit added an undocumented current-Zone-object guard.
findings.why_it_matters: A valid exit event could leave the app claiming to watch after exit dwell completed.

findings.what: Overdue CHECKIN_1, CHECKIN_2 and FAMILY_ESCALATED recovery omitted foreground-service restart commands.
findings.why_it_matters: A restarted process could advance the ladder without restoring foreground execution.

findings.what: The synthetic Zone helper's inert default riskScore 0.5 matched the unrelated display-risk example fact.
findings.why_it_matters: This was a wrong-but-same-valued provenance pass, so mechanical G6 alone was falsely green.

findings.what: The declared fact count was 248 while the facts array contained 279 entries.
findings.why_it_matters: The provenance graph was internally inconsistent after adding the approved T4.1 facts, so consumers could not trust its declared cardinality.
